environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached with the following configuration: (1) A custom rule with priority 1 using a RegexPatternSet that matches request query string values against patterns containing SQL comment sequences, UNION keywords adjacent to SELECT, and single-quote followed by OR/AND with equality patterns — action BLOCK. (2) The task IAM role has a permissions boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/DenyDBFileSystemAccess) that denies s3:GetObject and prevents any exfiltration path for extracted data. (3) The ECS task definition sets the container filesystem as read-only (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) with only /tmp and /var/lib/app mounted as tmpfs with 10MB size limit, meaning the SQLite database is ephemeral with no persistent sensitive data — it is seeded on container start with only synthetic test records.

config.database_seeding: ephemeral synthetic data only, re-seeded on each task start
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet, no direct instance access
